snippet.title: Shadows of Chroma Tower - Official Gameplay trailer 2026
snippet.description:
Shadows of Chroma Tower is a first-person exploration game that combines the best elements of dungeon crawlers with ARPGs. With highly stylized graphics and gigantic bosses, players must carefully manage positioning, resources, and risks while exploring the tower, deciding when to advance or extract with their items. The mix of tactical combat and extraction mechanics creates tense and strategic matches.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/27...
